definitions.gloss: price increase, rise in price, appreciation
definitions.explanation: A rise in the price or value of goods, services, or assets. Describes an upward change in price from the consumer's or market perspective.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{値上|ねあ}がり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{電気代|でんきだい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{値上|ねあ}がり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{圧迫|あっぱく}→圧迫：12013_appaku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Rising electricity costs are putting pressure on household finances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原材料|げんざいりょう}→原材料：18966_genzairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{値上|ねあ}がり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見直|みなお}されている→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: Due to the rise in raw material prices, the prices of many products are being reviewed.

notes:
The opposite is ⟦{値下|ねさ}がり→値下がり：22228_nesagari⟧ (price decrease). A related but different term is ⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧ (a deliberate price hike by a seller), whereas {値上|ねあ}がり describes the price going up on its own or from external factors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {値上|ねあ}がり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (prices continue to rise)
- ⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な{値上|ねあ}がり (significant price increase)
- ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{値上|ねあ}がり (stock price appreciation)
- {値上|ねあ}がり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見込|みこ}む→見込む：08315_mikomu⟧ (expect prices to rise)
